description: Any shock or tingling from the appliance, a tap or a body panel
protective_message: Please keep the appliance and its MCB switched off, do not touch it or any tap connected to it, and keep children away. We are arranging a technician.

description: Smoke, sparks, melting or a burning smell
protective_message: Please unplug it or switch it off at the MCB if you can do so without touching it, keep away from it and open a window.

description: Water running onto a switchboard, socket or the appliance's electrics
protective_message: Please switch off the MCB for that circuit and keep away from the wet area.

description: Chemical or gas smell from a refrigerator
protective_message: Please keep flames and switches away, open windows and do not run the refrigerator.

description: Refrigerator not cooling and food, milk or medicine is at risk
protective_message: Please keep the door closed and move milk and medicines to a neighbour's refrigerator if you can.

description: No cooling with an infant, an elderly person or a medical need at home
Active water leak that switching the appliance off does not stop
protective_message: Please close the water inlet tap for the appliance.

description: Same fault again within 30 days of a repair
No hot water with an infant or elderly person at home
Working partly, or stopped with nothing at risk
